query: Consider the following context: High Entropy Alloy nanoparticles (HEA NPs) have been synthetized because they are promising materials to improve nanoscale performance. However, little theoretical study has been carried out regarding the thermal stability of HEA NPs. In that context, which method can be used for study the thermal response of FeCuCrCoNi HEA NPs as a function of size, and why?
